appText: Ünsiyet is an AI-assisted Islamic life companion that brings together prayer times, a qibla compass, the Holy Quran, hadiths, duas and a dhikr counter. Religious texts come only from trusted publications and are shown unchanged.

privacyItems.title: Kept on your device
privacyItems.text: Your favorites, reading history, last read verse, dhikr counts, settings, chat history and last location are kept only on this device. Ünsiyet has no accounts; we keep no personal data about you on our servers.

privacyItems.title: Location
privacyItems.text: Your location is used on your device only to calculate prayer times and the qibla direction, and is not sent to our servers. To show the name of your area, the coordinates are passed to your device’s location service (Apple or Google).

privacyItems.title: Chat
privacyItems.text: What you write in the chat and the mood you pick are passed through our server to the AI provider to produce a reply. Our server does not store your messages. How the provider handles data is subject to its own privacy policy.

privacyItems.title: Free questions
privacyItems.text: To count the free questions, the app adds a random install code to chat requests. Our server keeps only this code's question count and, to prevent abuse, a daily request count under a one-way hash of the IP address for a short time; neither is linked to your name or an account. Premium is confirmed by checking the purchase proof with Apple or Google.

privacyItems.title: Notifications
privacyItems.text: Prayer time reminders are scheduled on your device; this information is not sent to any server.

privacyItems.title: Purchases
privacyItems.text: Premium purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play. Your payment details never reach us.

privacyItems.title: Control of your data
privacyItems.text: You can export or delete all your data in Profile → Settings → Data.

aiText: The Ünsiyet chat works with OpenAI’s language models. Your messages are passed to the OpenAI API to produce a reply. When you dictate, your voice recording is sent to OpenAI only to be converted to text and is not kept by the app. The model does not write verse, hadith or dua texts; every suggested text is shown from the app’s own verified sources.
disclaimer: Ünsiyet is an AI assistant; for religious rulings, please consult a qualified scholar.
dataNote: Ünsiyet has no accounts; your data is kept only on this device. Deleting removes everything on the device.
deleteLabel: Delete my account and all my data
deleteText: Your favorites, reading history, dhikr counts, chat history, settings, saved location and scheduled notifications will be permanently deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
